int main() {
    int n;
    std::cin >> n;
    std::string st;
    std::cin >> st;
    std::vector<char> c(st.begin(), st.end());

    int a1 = 0, a2 = 0;
    std::string sb, sb2;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (c[i] == '(') {
            sb += "_";
            i++;
            while (i < n && c[i] != ')') {
                sb2 += c[i];
                i++;
            }
            sb2 += "_";
        } else if (i < n) {
            sb += c[i];
        }
    }

    std::vector<std::string> s;
    size_t pos = 0, start = 0;
    while ((pos = sb.find('_', start)) != std::string::npos) {
        s.push_back(sb.substr(start, pos - start));
        start = pos + 1;
    }
    if (start < sb.size()) {
        s.push_back(sb.substr(start));
    }

    for (const auto& str : s) {
        a1 = std::max(a1, (int)str.length());
    }

    s.clear();
    start = 0;
    while ((pos = sb2.find('_', start)) != std::string::npos) {
        s.push_back(sb2.substr(start, pos - start));
        start = pos + 1;
    }
    if (start < sb2.size()) {
        s.push_back(sb2.substr(start));
    }

    for (const auto& str : s) {
        if (!str.empty()) a2++;
    }

    std::cout << a1 << " " << a2 << std::endl;

    return 0;
}
